Method of Attack: Disguised as legitimate apps to trick users into installation
Distributing banking trojans, adware, RATs, and malware downloaders
Redirecting users from malicious adult sites and social media spam to fake Flash Player download sites
Changing app purpose during installation to evade suspicion
Downloading additional malware based on command & control server instructions
Attack Vector: Fake app downloads from malicious websites (e.g., flash-update.info)
Installation of apps from outside the official Play Store
